creator: Alexander Terp
description:
ParseFile and WriteFile are exported "for tooling", but a caller outside the
package can only *preserve* output values, never inspect or change them. Verified
by round-tripping a file through both: the bytes come back identical, so nothing
is lost - but outVal and the expected/actual maps are unexported with no getters,
so external code is blind to what it is carrying.

That is enough for a reformatter and not enough for the review tool that .snap.new
is reserved for. A review tool has to read the accepted file's expected values,
read the pending file's proposed values, render the difference, and write back
whichever the human picked. All four steps need a surface that does not exist.

Shape is open. Probably Case.Expected(channel) (string, bool) plus an Int variant
and Step equivalents for reading, and something narrower than apply() for setting -
apply() promotes actual into expected and assumes a completed Suite.Run, which a
tool has not got.

Decide this before designing the review tool, not after: a tool built around the
current surface will grow a workaround that then has to be unpicked. Additive, so
it does not block v0.1.0 - but the honest alternative is unexporting ParseFile and
WriteFile until the story is real, rather than shipping a promise the API does not
keep.
title: Complete the tooling surface: read and set expected outputs
